title: TokTickIT Sprint 4 Visual and Accessibility QA Checklist
inspectedScreens: IT Staff Ticket Detail & Actions Taken Workspace

noClipping.description: No clipping observed in required Lab 4 screens; page-level horizontal overflow is bounded with targeted geometry checks on representative controls.

noOverlap.description: No unintended overlap observed in required Lab 4 screens; pairwise bounding-box checks cover dashboard metric cards, Actions Taken form fields, and representative navigation controls.

noHorizontalOverflow.description: Document scrollWidth strictly <= window.innerWidth across all viewports

visibleFocusStates.description: Representative required interactive controls have a visible Zen Green keyboard focus ring (2px solid rgb(25, 135, 84) with 2px offset) verified during keyboard traversal

nonColorStatusCues.description: Explicit textual badges for all statuses (NEW, OPEN, IN_PROGRESS, etc.) and priorities

mobileTouchTargets.description: Required mobile interactive controls (buttons, select, switches, navigation, form-control inputs) strictly meet >= 44x44px dimensions on mobile viewports

semanticLabels.description: Representative forms (Login, Create Ticket, Actions Taken) verify explicit label[for] associations and accessible button names

editableVsReadOnly.description: Clear visual distinction: readOnly attributes and #F0F4F2 vs #FFFFFF styling

validationPlacement.description: Required representative validation alert banners and inline invalid-feedback elements positioned directly adjacent to relevant form inputs

conclusion: All major Lab 4 screens and preserved Lab 1-3 screens satisfy the approved Zen Green visual, responsive, and accessibility contract.
